# Invoice Processing & Archiving — V3

### How it works
- Collect Gmail PDFs from the editor or on a six-hour schedule.
- Validate invoice fields, assign categories and check Sheets for duplicates.
- Resolve year/month/category folders in Drive, upload or recover PDFs, then update the invoice register.
- Log invalid documents in Review Queue; optionally label Gmail messages and email a summary.

### Setup
- Connect Gmail, Drive and Sheets OAuth2. Narrow the Gmail query and review its 90-day lookback.
- Set the Drive folder ID, currency and categories in **Configuration**; adapt parsing rules.
- Create `Invoices` and `Review Queue` tabs using the mapped headers. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID` in all three Sheets nodes.
- Test valid, rejected, duplicate and multi-attachment PDFs before activating the schedule.

### Requirements
- n8n, Gmail, and write access to the chosen Drive folder and spreadsheet.
- Text-based PDFs up to 20 MiB; scanned documents require external OCR.

### Customization
- Adjust the query, schedule, categories, field patterns and column mappings.
- Optionally configure Gmail label IDs and `reportEmail`.
- For OCR/AI, configure HTTPS endpoints, HTTP authentication and `aiModel`, then enable their flags in **Configuration**.

### Additional info

- [Setup and operations for this version](https://github.com/paoloronco/n8n-templates/blob/main/workflows/invoice-archiving/V3/README.md)
- Original Gmail messages are retained.
- Negative or unsupported totals require review.
- Drive and Sheets are not transactional; avoid overlapping runs.
- OCR/AI services are not bundled and stay off by default.
- Service failures can stop execution before the summary.

## Collect PDF attachments
Fetch matching Gmail messages from the last 90 days. Split attachments into linked PDF items; skip other files and reject PDFs over 20 MiB. Configure credentials and narrow the search query.

## Read each PDF once
Process one attachment at a time. Use embedded PDF text, or an optional authenticated OCR endpoint when text is missing. OCR stays off until configured; unreadable documents can enter review.

## Validate before archiving
Extract vendor, invoice number, dates, amount and category. Optional AI can recover missing fields from available text. Both extraction paths use the same date, amount and identity rules.

## Keep rejected documents visible
Upsert invalid documents into Review Queue with a reason and source message ID. Optional Gmail labels mark messages for attention. Source emails are retained.

## Skip registered invoices
Search Invoices by vendor/invoice/date key. Preserve the validated record from either rules or AI before the lookup. Registered keys skip Drive operations; unregistered records continue.

## Resolve the archive destination
Find exact year, month and category names inside the configured parent; create only missing folders. Searches exclude trash. In the final category folder, look for the exact canonical PDF filename.

## Upload or recover, then register
Reuse an existing PDF or upload the missing binary. Upsert metadata into Invoices, optionally label the Gmail message and record the archived outcome. Drive/Sheets failures can require a rerun.

## Report completed outcomes
The loop collects archived, duplicate and review results. One optional email reports these counts and archived totals per currency. Set reportEmail in Configuration; hard service failures can stop the run before reporting.
